summary: The dashboard had only a task board and demo data. Adds two pages built with the image from docs/data/experiments.json, where each section names its source: /experiments/ (coverage before and after, mutation score, minutes from the request to the result, merges by merge_guard, hidden-test results) and /environment/ (the SCI of one mutation run with each tool, computed with scripts/sci_estimate.py, with the assumptions printed and the limits stated: power estimated, no embodied emissions, one comparison). Charts are inline SVG with a legend for two series, direct value labels, a table view and no script; the two series colours pass the palette validator in light and dark. The nav links to both pages. 25 tests failed on the old code.
